needs.description: Complete adult maintenance dry kibble formulated for medium/large breeds (50 lb maintenance calories) with novel protein or chicken-free recipe (e.g., fish, lamb, or turkey-free if cross-reactive). Medium-size kibble to encourage chewing; sold in 12–30 lb bags to match household usage.
needs.rationale: Daily staple — dog must eat a balanced adult diet every day. This Shar Pei has a documented chicken allergy, so a chicken-free kibble is essential to avoid allergic reactions and maintain skin health.

needs.description: Continuous-flow pet water fountain (plastic or stainless) with replaceable carbon filter and 1–2L capacity to keep water circulating and cooler, encouraging frequent drinking in an apartment setting.
needs.rationale: Fresh water available at all times is required daily. Current excessive heat warning increases dehydration risk — a fountain improves intake and keeps water cooler in warm conditions.

needs.description: Durable, leak-resistant biodegradable/compostable poop bags in dispenser-ready rolls (standard 9x13 inch) for daily walks and indoor disposal.
needs.rationale: Daily excretion disposal is a basic need for an apartment dog. Reliable bags prevent messes and odor buildup in shared building spaces.

needs.description: Portable, non-electric cooling mat sized for a 50 lb dog (medium/large), pressure-activated or gel-cooling surface that stays cool without refrigeration. Machine-washable cover or wipeable surface.
needs.rationale: Excessive heat warning in zip 98052 creates immediate heat-risk indoors for an apartment dog. A cooling mat reduces heat-stress quickly and is an immediate safety item.

needs.description: Small, low-calorie soft training treats or bite-sized freeze-dried treats made from single non-chicken protein (e.g., beef-free if necessary — fish, duck, or lamb options) for daily reinforcement; resealable packaging.
needs.rationale: Daily positive reinforcement helps maintain good apartment manners and allows quick rewards during walks or training. Must be chicken-free to avoid allergen exposure.

needs.family: Wrinkle & skin-fold cleansing wipes or foam
needs.description: pH-balanced, antibacterial/antifungal wipes or gentle foam specifically for facial/body folds (alcohol-free, fragrance-free) in single-wipe format to clean between skin folds daily-to-weekly as needed.
needs.rationale: Shar Peis have deep skin folds prone to moisture trapping and secondary infections. Regular fold cleaning is preventive care to reduce dermatitis risk.

needs.description: pH-balanced dog ear cleaner (non-irritating, hypoallergenic) in a bottle with nozzle tip for weekly or as-needed cleaning of floppy or wrinkled ears; alcohol-free.
needs.rationale: Breed’s skin folds and ear conformation can predispose to ear debris/irritation; routine cleaning prevents infections and keeps ears comfortable in apartment living.

needs.description: Padded front-clip harness sized for a 50 lb dog (adjustable straps, quick-release buckles) to reduce pulling and give safer control during apartment/street walks.
needs.rationale: Apartment living relies on efficient, safe walks. A harness provides better control, reduces neck strain, and helps manage unexpected noises (leaf blowers, Halloween doorbells, hunting season).

needs.family: Reflective leash or LED leash attachment
needs.description: Reflective-coated leash or USB-rechargeable LED strip/clip that attaches to leash for evening visibility; water-resistant and bright for city walks.
needs.rationale: Hunting season and shorter daylight (Daylight Saving End) plus apartment street-walking increase need for visibility; prevents accident risk during low-light walks.

needs.description: Weighted, non-slip slow-feeder bowl sized for adult medium/large dogs to slow gulping and promote digestion (dishwasher-safe).
needs.rationale: Medium activity apartment dogs can eat quickly; slowing intake reduces regurgitation risk and helps digestion.

needs.description: Sturdy elevated feeder (one or two bowls) sized for a 50 lb dog to reduce neck strain; stainless steel bowls to avoid odors and for easy cleaning.
needs.rationale: Moderate-size adult dogs sometimes benefit from slightly elevated bowls for ergonomics; helps cleaner feeding area in small apartment.

needs.description: Dental chews sized for medium/large dogs formulated to reduce plaque/tartar, explicitly chicken-free and low-fat; used several times per week as preventive dental care.
needs.rationale: Dental health is a preventive best practice; chews help reduce plaque accumulation and can be started in adults to preserve oral health.

needs.family: Rubber curry brush & grooming glove set
needs.description: Soft rubber curry brush/grooming glove suited for short coats to reduce loose hair and stimulate skin; easy to use in apartment to reduce dander and allergen buildup.
needs.rationale: Regular grooming reduces skin irritation and removes debris from folds; also helps during fall allergy season and indoor living.

needs.description: Quiet rotary nail grinder (or quality guillotine clippers) with safety guard for at-home nail maintenance and smoothing; cordless grinders help avoid stress in apartment spaces.
needs.rationale: Apartment dogs need routine nail upkeep to avoid noise, damage to floors, and discomfort. A grinder reduces clamping and splinter risk.

needs.description: Enzyme stain and odor remover for pet urine and organic stains, safe for fabrics and carpets, to manage apartment odor between deep cleans.
needs.rationale: No-yard apartment living increases reliance on indoor cleanliness. Enzyme cleaners break down odors and reduce repeat marking or odor retention.

needs.description: Stuffable rubber treat-dispensing toy (hollow center) sized for average chewers that can hold small treats or kibble; dishwasher-safe and non-toxic.
needs.rationale: Provides mental stimulation and slow-feeding enrichment for indoor apartment time; appropriate for average chewers to extend engagement.

needs.description: Interactive puzzle feeder or snuffle mat to hide kibble/treats and encourage foraging behavior; machine washable pieces for apartment use.
needs.rationale: Indoor enrichment that stimulates natural foraging and reduces boredom, important when outdoor time is limited and during rain season.

needs.description: Durable, non-edible long-lasting nylon or composite chew appropriate for average chewers, sized for medium/large dogs to occupy time and reduce destructive behavior.
needs.rationale: Reduces boredom and provides safe outlet for chewing in an apartment; avoids edible chews that may contain chicken.

needs.description: Durable tug rope for interactive owner-dog play; medium thickness for average chew strength, with secure knotting and washable fibers.
needs.rationale: Interactive play builds bond and provides physical exercise indoors when outdoor time is limited, helping manage energy in apartment living.

needs.description: Soft, carpet-safe indoor ball or plush fetch toy designed not to damage furniture or create loud noises in an apartment; medium size for 50 lb dog.
needs.rationale: Allows short indoor fetch sessions without disturbing neighbors; useful during rainy days or early/late walks.

needs.description: Adjustable calming wrap (thundershirt-style) sized for medium/large dogs to provide gentle pressure during loud events (leaf blowers, Halloween doorbells, hunting season noises).
needs.rationale: Calendar events (leaf blower, hunting season, Halloween) can cause stress; a calming wrap is a non-medical tool to reduce anxiety during those times.

needs.description: Supportive memory-foam bed sized for a 50 lb dog with washable cover and low profile for easy access in an apartment; breathable fabric recommended for warmer months.
needs.rationale: Provides comfortable resting surface for daily naps and joint support; improves sleep quality and offers a dedicated space in small living areas.

needs.description: Beginner scent training kit with scent containers, washable scent pads, and an instruction booklet to run short indoor scent games.
needs.rationale: Shar Peis benefit from mental stimulation; nose work is low-impact, enriching, and ideal for rainy days or limited outdoor access.

needs.description: Hands-free treat pouch with secure closure and poop-bag dispenser for carrying chicken-free treats and bags on walks; clip for belt or waistband.
needs.rationale: Improves convenience for frequent short apartment walks and training reinforcement on the go.

needs.description: Pet-safe paw balm to moisturize pads and protect from hot surfaces; small tin or tube for occasional use after hot pavement exposure or indoor dryness.
needs.rationale: Excessive heat warning increases risk of hot pavement; paw balm provides protection and is a handy apartment-first-aid non-medical product.

needs.family: Small USB-rechargeable clip-on LED safety light
needs.description: Compact clip-on LED safety light that attaches to collar for extra visibility at night; rechargeable, water-resistant, multiple flash modes.
needs.rationale: Supplemental visibility for late/evening walks during hunting season and shorter daylight; low-cost reassurance in apartment neighborhood.
